# Principal Engineer, Platform Reliability — Beacon Systems

Fictional JD used to demonstrate jobber.

## About the role

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to lead platform reliability across our infrastructure organization. You will set the technical direction for incident response, on-call tooling, deploy safety, and observability used by 400+ engineers across the company. The role is hands-on and player-coach: you set the standards, write the reference implementations, and review the code.

## Responsibilities

- Own the technical strategy for the deploy-safety and incident-response platform end-to-end, from concept through production rollout.
- Personally build reference implementations for high-leverage tools (e.g., feature flagging, runbook automation, SLO reporting) that other teams will adopt.
- Lead a focused team of 4 to 6 staff engineers; mentor across the broader engineering org.
- Define service-level objectives, error budgets, and reliability metrics. Personally review and approve major architecture decisions.
- Drive cross-org migrations: bring 100+ services onto common tooling for feature flags, deploy gates, and observability.
- Establish coding, testing, and documentation standards for platform components.
- Represent the company externally: publish or speak on platform reliability topics where appropriate.

## Required qualifications

- 10+ years building backend systems, with sustained personal technical contribution.
- Demonstrated track record shipping platform tooling that other engineers actually adopt.
- Deep expertise in distributed systems: Kafka, Kubernetes, distributed databases, observability stacks.
- Strong applied background in deploy safety, on-call, and incident response.
- Comfortable reviewing implementations and being close to the code and data.

## Preferred qualifications

- Experience with feature-flag systems and runbook automation.
- Open-source contributions or maintainer experience with clear product relevance.
- Public speaking on infrastructure topics.
- Experience in regulated or healthcare software environments.
- Optimizing systems for scale, latency, and cost.
